title: The Serum Run

slides.title: THE 12-YEAR-OLD DOG WHO RAN THE DEADLIEST LEG

slides.text: A relay of sled dog teams was racing medicine across Alaska to save the children of Nome.
Musher Leonhard Seppala and his lead dog Togo raced out from Nome to meet the medicine on the trail.
To save a whole day, Togo led the team straight across Norton Sound: miles of frozen sea ice, in the dark, in a storm.
Sea ice can break away and drift out to open water, taking a whole dog team with it.
Togo's team ran about 146 km (91 miles) of the relay, the longest leg, and around 420 km (260 miles) in all.

Then they handed the medicine on. The dog who carried it into Nome would become the most famous dog in America. But was he the real hero?
Part 3: Balto.

caption: Togo was 12 years old when he led his team across miles of frozen sea in the dark to get the medicine to Nome. The Serum Run, part 2 of 3.
